attributes.personal_agency: Personal (self) agency: the degree to which the user shows capability and control to achieve personal goals through their own actions. High scores indicate explicit ownership, intentional action, and confidence in carrying out goal-directed behavior; low scores indicate little sense of personal control or action capability.
attributes.proxy_agency: Proxy agency: the degree to which the user relies on another agent's capabilities (for example an AI chatbot or advisor) to help achieve goals when their own control or expertise is limited. High scores indicate trust in the proxy, willingness to delegate decisions/actions, and expectation the proxy can regulate or guide outcomes; low scores indicate little reliance on an external proxy.
attributes.collective_agency: Collective agency: the degree to which goal pursuit is framed as coordinated capability and shared control across multiple actors (user + AI + human collaborators). High scores indicate explicit team coordination, role complementarity, and shared efficacy in delivering outcomes; low scores indicate no meaningful team-level coordination.
